title: ArcBest Named to 2027 FreightTech100 List
summary: ArcBest has been named to the 2027 FreightTech100 list, recognizing our ongoing investment in tech and innovation across transportation and logistics.
body_markdown:
## Recognized among the industry’s leading freight tech innovators


ArcBest has been named to the[FreightWaves 2027 FreightTech100](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/freightwaves-announces-the-2027-freighttech100) , an annual list recognizing companies making a significant impact on freight and supply chain technology. This is the fifth time ArcBest has earned a place on the list, also in 2024, 2023, 2022 and 2020, reflecting our continued focus on developing technology that simplifies logistics and creates better customer experiences.


We combine more than 100 years of logistics expertise with an annual investment of approximately $175 million in tech and innovation to develop solutions that help customers move freight more efficiently and navigate increasingly complex supply chains. That commitment includes applying technology to some of the most pressing challenges in transportation and logistics, including freight management and visibility.


A recent example, and a key part of this year’s recognition, is[ArcBest View](https://view.arcb.com/) ™, the company’s digital logistics platform designed to address the fragmented systems of traditional freight management. By bringing quoting, booking, shipment visibility and reporting into one connected experience, View helps customers manage freight activity across ArcBest solutions with greater control and transparency.


For the 2027 list, the FreightWaves Research team evaluated nominations based on documented innovation, market impact and how each company’s ideas evolved during the previous year. The FreightTech100 list also serves as the foundation for the FreightTech 25. An independent panel of industry executives will evaluate the honorees, with the top 25 companies announced October 26 at the F3 Awards Dinner.


Learn more about[ArcBest’s technology](https://arcb.com/technology) .
